svg.title: The Carter Family Relationships
svg.desc: Arthur and Ruth are the parents of Michael, whose partnership with Claire connects to Anna, Ben and Grace; Anna carries the index outline. Separate smooth gutter arcs identify Arthur–Anna cutoff, Ruth–Michael three-line fusion and Michael–Grace zigzag conflict with hash marks, distinct from the solid family branches.
